notes:
Pages 1-5 are OCR of the map plates and are heavily garbled; only the legible explanation text of plate 1 was used, and unit symbols read as Qif/Qip in the OCR are recorded as Qlf/Qlp (inferred). Plate 1 assigns no unit names to the two youngest sand descriptions except 'Terrace deposits along Goose Creek' and 'Sand on Tenmile Hill'; the middle description is attributed to the Pamlico formation by inference from page 15. Ladson formation maximum thickness: plate 1 says 33 feet, the abstract (page 15) says 35 feet; both recorded. Logs on pages 25, 41 and 48 give bed thicknesses, not depths; thicknesses are put in interval notes rather than converted to depths. The type-section auger hole number is garbled ('2^2') and recorded as 242 from figure 5 (inferred). Fossil tables on pages 27-28 and 42-43 are garbled and were not itemized.
Text layer pages; some characters garbled (Munsell hue 'Y' printed as 'F', fractions such as 'J^', '%' and '1J_!' in thickness columns). Thickness columns with garbled fractions were not recorded; bed thicknesses that are legible are given in interval notes, not converted to depths. Pollen tables (pages 62-63), X-ray table 3, chemical analyses (tables 4-5, pages 77-80) and the phosphate production table (page 85) were not itemized. Soil profiles on pages 87 and 94 (soil horizons, not geologic units) were not recorded as observations. The Ladson formation members continue from packet 1.
Auger-hole logs (pages 101-112) give bed thicknesses, not depths; thicknesses are put in interval notes (only where legible) and not converted to depths. Several hole numbers are garbled in the text layer (2S1, 282, 28S, 285, 2861, 840, ^41, 849, 851, 258) and were read from the sequence and cross-references (e.g. hole 253 near the Ashley Marl Works, page 67) -- flagged inferred. Munsell hues printed as 'F' were read as 'Y' (inferred). Log of hole 242 is on page 48 (packet 1). Soil profiles on page 95 (Popperdam Creek road cut) were not recorded. References: only South Carolina-related entries of the bibliography were recorded; general and out-of-state references were skipped; citations are lightly normalized from the printed text (e.g. 'Alien' read as 'Allen', 'Button' as 'Dutton').
